findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Inspector observed an accumulation of biofilm on the front baffles of the ice machine. Discussed with the person in charge (PIC). The ice machine should be emptied, cleaned, and sanitized. Clean food contact surfaces (both front AND back of the baffles)  at a frequency to ensure they are maintained clean to sight and touch.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. [Pf]

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: The facility has failed to obtain in-date test strips. The inspector will continue to schedule follow up inspections until the facility has obtained an in-date test kit to verify proper chemical sanitizing concentration. Fees for scheduled follow up inspections increase with each occurrance.
findings.citation_text: 4-302.14 Sanitizing Solutions, Testing Devices. A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided. [Pf]

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: Inspector observed expired quaternary ammonia test strips. Quaternary ammonia is used to clean food contact surfaces within the facility- therefore a test kit to verify proper sanitizing concentrations is required. Inspector will return to check for compliance on 3/19.
findings.citation_text: 4-302.14 Sanitizing Solutions, Testing Devices. A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided. [Pf]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Inspector observed missing door handle at the back door. The PIC stated a new door handle has been ordered. Facilities shall be maintained in good repair. Inspector will check that the door handle has been replaced during the 3/19 re-inspection.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. [C]

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: Inspector observed multiple incidents of employees switching tasks without washing hands. CORRECTED- inspector discussed times to wash hands with the person in charge (PIC). Ensure all employees frequently review required times to wash hands, which includes but is not limited to: after cleaning, after touching personal items, when switching between handling raw and ready to eat food items, etc.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.14 When to Wash. FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms as specified under § 2-301.12 immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including working with exposed FOOD, clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS, and unwrapped SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES and: (A) After touching bare human body parts other than clean hands and clean, exposed portions of arms; (B) After using the toilet room; (C) After caring for or handling SERVICE ANIMALS or aquatic animals as specified in 2-403.11(B); (D) Except as specified in 2-401.11(B), after coughing, sneezing, using a handkerchief or disposable tissue, using TOBACCO PRODUCTS, eating, or drinking; (E) After handling soiled EQUIPMENT or UTENSILS; (F) During FOOD preparation, as often as necessary to remove soil and contamination and to prevent cross contamination when changing tasks; (G) When switching between working with raw FOOD and working with READY-TO-EAT FOOD; (H) Before donning gloves to initiate a task that involves working with FOOD; and (I) After engaging in other activities that contaminate the hands. [P]

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Inspector observed the soap dispenser in the restroom nearest the back door to not be dispensing. CORRECTED, the PIC removed and cleaned the dispenser, to be placed at the sink basin for patrons to dispense themselves. Discussed purchasing a pump soap until the current dispenser is repaired or replaced with the PIC. Ensure all sinks designated for hand washing always have warm running water, paper towels, and soap for proper hand washing.
findings.citation_text: 6-301.11 Handwashing Cleanser, Availability. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of 2 adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. [P]

findings.title: Thermometers are provided and accurate.
findings.comment: Inspector observed the stem thermometer within the facility to be out of calibration. CORRECTED- the PIC calibrated the thermometer using the ice water method. Ensure all stem thermometers are maintained in proper calibration to ensure proper cooking, cooling, and reheating temperatures.
findings.citation_text: 4-502.11(B) Good Repair and Calibration. (B) FOOD TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES shall be calibrated in accordance with manufacturer's specifications as necessary to ensure their accuracy. [Pf]

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used.
findings.comment: SECOND REPEAT- Metal shelving used for container storage was observed to be rusted. The PIC has cleaned the rust off of some of the shelves, however due to the design of the shelves/ amount of surface area that is currently rusted, replacing them will prevent potential for contamination of the food contact surfaces.
findings.citation_text: 4-101.19 Nonfood-Contact Surfaces. NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other FOOD soiling or that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a CORROSION-RESISTANT, nonabsorbent, and SMOOTH material. [C]

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used.
findings.comment: FIRST REPEAT- Metal shelving used for container storage in dry storage was observed to be rusted. Shelving will need to be painted or replaced so that the surfaces are smooth and easily cleanable.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment:
Raw shell eggs were observed stored on the top shelf of the 2 door cooler, above ready to eat foods (cooled meatballs, soups, etc). CORRECTED- Shell eggs (and meatballs, soups stored below) were all also out of temperature and were voluntarily discarded. Store eggs below ready-to-eat foods.
3-302.11: (A) (1)-(2) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display. [P]

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
All foods in the 2 door cooler were observed from 49F to 52F (probed). Foods included (but not limited to) pastrami, roast beef, turkey, ham, sliced cheeses, soups, shell eggs, and mayonnaise. Condiments labeled “refrigerate for quality,” pickles, cut raw cucumber, olives, and onions were kept. All other foods were voluntarily discarded.
3-501.16: (A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. (B) EGGS not treated to destroy Salmonellae shall be stored at 45F or less. [P]

findings.title: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control
findings.comment:
The 2 door cooler is holding foods at 49-52F. There is water ponding in the bottom of the cooler and on the lids of containers. Foods in the cooler were voluntarily discarded. Make the necessary repairs to ensure that the cooler is functioning properly and holds foods at 41F or below.
4-301.11: EQUIPMENT for cooling and heating FOOD, and holding cold and hot FOOD, shall be sufficient in number and capacity to provide FOOD temperatures. [Pf]

findings.title: Thermometers provided & accurate
findings.comment:
1st REPEAT: No ambient air thermometer was observed in the 2 door cooler. PIC moved a thermometer from the prep cooler to the 2 door cooler to monitor the temperature. Ensure all cold holding units (2 door cooler and prep cooler) have thermometers placed inside.
4-204.112: (A) In refrigerated or hot FOOD storage unit, TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE shall be located to measure air temperature. (B) EQUIPMENT holding TCS FOOD shall have TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE affixed to device. [C]

findings.title: Thermometers provided & accurate
findings.comment: Food thermometer was reading around 100F at ambient temperature. CORRECTED- Ice water method was used to calibrate the thermometer to 32F during inspection. The bolt on the facility’s probe thermometer is loose, making the thermometer very easily uncalibrated. Consider purchasing a thermometer that is better able to hold calibration. Ensure the food thermometer is checked, calibrated, and used daily to verify proper temperatures.
findings.citation_text: 4-203.11 Food temperature measuring devices that are scaled only in Fahrenheit shall be accurate to ±2F in the intended range of use. [Pf]

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
2nd REPEAT: Gaskets on the 2 door storage cooler are falling off of the doors. Repair or replace gaskets.
4-501.11: (A) EQUIPMENT shall be maintained in good repair. (B) EQUIPMENT components shall be kept intact, tight, and adjusted to manufacturer’s specifications. [C]
